recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not reintroduce characterization wording into SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation; any future characterization example or terminology refinements should be raised against SubstanceDefinition.characterization or its terminology.
issue_request: FHIR-26939 asked to change SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation from "Molecular structural representation" to a depiction of the substance structure and/or characterization, with examples such as a molecular structure graphic, InChI string value, JCAMP file, or AnIML file.
initial_application: Commit ae0d9e06 changed the 2020 SubstanceDefinition spreadsheet source from "Molecular structural representation" to "A depiction of the structure or characterization of the substance" and broadened related representation child definitions to include characterization examples. The implementation did not explicitly mention FHIR-26939, but it matches the seed request and same-date BRR approval family.
additional_context: SubstanceDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini. Related FHIR-26940 is already audited on the combined branch. Later Published/Persuasive BRR decisions narrowed the current model: FHIR-32115 removed characterization-technique wording from representation.type, and FHIR-39596 added SubstanceDefinition.characterization as the separate home for characterization details, including characterization.technique and characterization.file.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source correctly keeps SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation focused on structural depiction while placing characterization files/examples under SubstanceDefinition.characterization.file; restoring the original characterization wording to structure.representation would conflict with later approved BRR decisions.

related_jiras.note: Approved in the same BRR motion and originally added characterization wording to representation.type; already audited on the combined branch as no-change after later model changes.
Removed characterization-technique wording from SubstanceDefinition.structure.representation.type because it duplicated structure.technique; already represented on the combined branch.
Added the SubstanceDefinition.characterization backbone and separated characterization details from structure/representation; already represented on the combined branch.
